newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PEPEES TO START BOURSE TRADE ON MAY 22.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PEPEES TO START BOURSE TRADE ON MAY 22.

text.p: Polish food producer PEPEES SA will start trade on the main market of the Warsaw bourse on May 22, the bourse said in a statement on Monday.
The firm, whose public offering of 152,100 existing shares at a minimum price of 100 zlotys took place last week, has the shares allotted at a special bourse session later on Monday.
